groups.clockwork_description: The phase character maps the plane orbifold *632 onto C2. The operation phases are 2-fold rotations: 0; 3-fold rotations: 0; 6-fold rotations: 0; reflections / glides: 1/2.
groups.coloring_description: The book colour type is *632/632: twofold is understood, so no exponent 2 is printed, and the orbifold signature after the slash is the colour-fixing kernel K = 632. Here [G:K] = 2 and G/K is isomorphic to C2. The one-slash form is valid because this cyclic colour action is regular, so the stabilizer H of one chosen colour equals K. An operation at phase j/2 sends colour k to k+j modulo 2.
